label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said what is expected is unclear. What is happening?

Every country team says their invoices are urgent, so last Tuesday when both Vietnam and Thailand demanded same-day payment, I picked Vietnam first and my lead was unhappy when Thailand's supplier was paid late. Without a clear priority order, I waste time asking around and sometimes miss my daily quota by about 20 invoices.
What would help you handle urgent invoices better?
A simple priority order from my lead or one person who decides would help me handle these better.

Here is what I will tell HR: Conflicting urgent requests without a clear priority order lead to wasted time and missed daily invoice quotas. [ROLE_CLARITY] "Without a clear priority order, I waste time asking around and sometimes miss my daily quota by about 20 invoices."
